spec.name: Trend v12
spec.notes: Twelve-month return skipping the most recent weeks, long the strongest fifth. Adds the vendor's revised sentiment score.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.8, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 5%.

exhibits.summary: Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.83 to -0.99 (change -2.82).
Under strict point-in-time data the Sharpe ratio moves from 1.83 to -1.18. Changed by strict mode: fields sentiment_revised.
At 10 bps the Sharpe ratio is 1.72 (as submitted, 8 bps: 1.83); it breaks even at 40.7 bps with daily turnover 0.11.
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 1.83 against 1.83 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
On the sealed period (strict mode, 10 bps) the Sharpe ratio is -1.41 against 1.83 in research, a gap of +3.24.
The best year gives 29% of total P&L (year 1) and calm regimes give 74%; Sharpe is 1.97 in calm and 1.62 in stressed regimes.
The log holds 5 distinct specs; the best of 5 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.77, so the claimed 1.80 becomes 1.03 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 2.28 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean -0.07, 95th percentile 0.50).
Perturbing the 3 numeric values in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.83 to as low as 0.37 (as low as 1.08 at 25%).
The top 1% of days (22 days) give 41% of total P&L and the top 5 assets give 31% (net of the strategy's own costs).

series.label: cumulative share of P&L, best days first

exhibits.summary: The scan (a heuristic) found no phrase addressed to reviewers or giving instructions in 2 text sources.

verdict.opinion: Rejected: core test damaging (lag_test EX-1, pit_replay EX-2, holdout_test EX-5).
